title: Re-Check Rate for the Calibration Procedure Fee, Calibration Workmanship Warranty
content:
**Rule.** Under the Workmanship Warranties, the calibration procedure fee in a calibration diagnostic charge under a Calibration Workmanship Warranty is charged according to the remedy attempts completed on the coverage with the concern resolved, network reworks and outside-shop repairs alike:

| Remedy attempts on the coverage completed with the concern resolved | Calibration procedure fee as charged |
|---|---|
| One was completed less than three whole calendar months before the charge date | halved and rounded down to the whole dollar |
| None less than three whole calendar months before, but one less than twelve whole calendar months before the charge date | multiplied by the late re-check share of 0.75 and rounded to the cent |
| None less than twelve whole calendar months before the charge date | charged in full |

## What counts

- Every remedy attempt on the coverage completed with the concern resolved counts, whether a network rework or an outside-shop repair; attempts completed not resolved do not count.
- The look-back is measured from the charge date in whole calendar months: less than three, then less than twelve.
- The rounding is part of each tier: down to the whole dollar in the first, to the cent in the second.

## Worked figures (hypothetical calibration procedure fee of USD 86.40)

| Most recent resolved completion | Calculation | Fee as charged |
|---|---|---|
| Less than three whole months before | USD 86.40 halved is USD 43.20, rounded down to the whole dollar | USD 43.00 |
| Four whole months before | USD 86.40 multiplied by 0.75 is USD 64.80 | USD 64.80 |
| Fifteen whole months before, none since | charged in full | USD 86.40 |
